title: Tidal Love numbers

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: As test 2/1, for the tidal Love numbers: an externally applied potential that does not load the surface. The relaxation frequencies s_j are unchanged, since they depend only on the model structure.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. For a converted test, the files read and what each column holds are in the `files` table of gia_mip/resources/spada_column_layouts.json. `not_converted` gives, per contributor, the reason its data is not in the converted file.

not_converted.ZM: T01-03/ holds tidal Love number files from GS, RR and VB only; no file is ZM's.

status: converted: GS, RR and VB in data/converted/spada2011/spada2011-t01-03.nc. ZM supplied no tidal Love numbers.
